Method of Attack: Ransomware deleting all Shadow Volume Copies using vssadmin.exe Delete Shadows /All /Quiet command to prevent file recovery
Injecting into administrator processes to avoid UAC prompts
Abusing CPU tuning tool to disable Microsoft Defender
Impacted Systems: Windows Vista and later versions with Shadow Volume Copies and System Restore features
Indicators of Compromise: Use of vssadmin.exe utility to delete shadow copies
Batch file renvss.bat to rename vssadmin.exe
